brief: Friday, August 14's snapshot has a throughline — 2026 Clacton by-election, which turned up on mastodon-trending, polymarket, wikipedia at once. Lightricks/LTX-2.5 made a quieter run across github and huggingface. Builders spent the day on cathrynlavery/diagram-design. On Steam, Counter-Strike 2 drew the biggest crowd.
